case.title: Fabricator alternates 5 and 4 to dodge the identical-answers rule

submissions.open_text: We buy twenty litres daily from a seller who comes by motorbike
Household fetches from the stream and boils it before drinking
Meter readings seem inaccurate and bills keep rising

case.why: A fabricator who knows that identical answers get flagged alternates between two adjacent values. The rule as written requires all 8 to be identical, so it must stay silent. An implementation that drifted to a fuzzier test, such as range <= 1, low variance, or at most 2 distinct values, would wrongly fire. This case pins the rule to its specification. Quiet checks: durations are at least 720 s. same_spot does not fire because the points are far apart: alt-mid differs by 0.008 deg lat (~890 m), alt-aft by 0.012 deg lng (~1.3 km), and mid-aft by 0.014 deg lat (~1.5 km), so no neighbour lies within 50 m. The texts share no content words. There are no voice notes. All times are daytime. One contributor uses the device. There are 3 submissions, fewer than the 4 that burst needs. All points are inside Kondele.
